action: Make the Local qualification entry select the current Candidate overlay set and require the installation-owned Local-Docker facts before Docker runs
necessity: The qualification entry is the apparatus that proves a real first deployment on this host. It composed only compose.yaml plus deploy/portable/compose.local-workspace.yaml, so the Fabric container started without OPL_FABRIC_PROVIDER and the run could never reach the provider stage; a qualification that cannot reach the provider stage cannot prove the first Agent deployment it exists to prove. The same entry also omitted the Control Plane's required Workspace host (OPL_WORKSPACE_DOMAIN) and the PostgreSQL data root (OPL_POSTGRES_DATA_ROOT, bound with create_host_path: false), so the stack could not start at all, and it invented the installation-owned Local-Docker facts instead of reading them. A run that invents the quota-enabled storage root or the provider profile qualifies a machine nobody deploys. The script now selects the overlays that carry the deployment mode and provider it fixes, and refuses to start with a named reason when either installation fact is absent, non-absolute, or an invalid profile.

checks: The fixture and live authority modes each select compose.yaml, the deployment overlay, the Fabric provider overlay, the Local-Workspace overlay and their mode-specific qualification overlay; an unknown mode is refused

The selected deployment and Fabric overlays carry OPL_DEPLOYMENT_MODE: platform_owned and OPL_FABRIC_PROVIDER: local-docker, so the selection cannot silently drift from the environment the script fixes

Missing, non-absolute and invalid installation inputs fail with the named codes local_docker_storage_root_missing, local_docker_storage_root_invalid, local_docker_provider_profile_missing and local_docker_provider_profile_invalid
A run without the installation inputs writes a NOT_READY receipt at stage installation_preflight with the named error code and never reaches Docker, image admission or Compose
The whole local-workspace-qualification test file passes (27 tests, 0 failures)

remainingBoundary: Source-only verification. No real Local-Docker host run, no Candidate build, provider procurement, production access, publication or deployment was performed; the live Local qualification remains the separate lane.
